articles.title: GAME DAY: Preds at Sharks, November 15
Faber ‘didn’t miss a beat’ in season debut for Wild after skull fracture
NHL EDGE stats behind Wallstedt’s breakout season for Wild
Hometown Remix: Prideful in black and green

away.summary: The Predators (11-5-5) are on the road against the Wild. Jonathan Marchessault returns after missing seven games with a lower-body injury, and Nicolas Hauge plays after being scratched the past eight games. Juuse Saros is projected to start but was described as a game-time decision by coach Andrew Brunette.

out.detail: upper body injury, placed on injured reserve

home.summary: The Wild (15-3-4) are at home and have an 11-game point streak. Brock Faber made his season debut after a skull fracture and preseason surgery. Jesper Wallstedt leads the NHL in wins and is projected to start in net with Filip Gustavsson injured.
